description: This bar chart, from the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models," illustrates the percentage point difference in performance between two multilingual BERT models, mBERT (light gray bars) and XLM-R (dark blue bars), across four different model configurations along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled "% point difference," is scaled linearly from -0.2 to +0.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The configurations are: "hidden:[50], linear" (where mBERT shows a -0.2 difference and XLM-R shows a -0.1 difference), "hidden:[], linear" (where mBERT shows a +0.1 difference and XLM-R shows a +0.2 difference), "hidden:[100], ReLU" (where mBERT shows a -0.1 difference and XLM-R shows a +0.05 difference), and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU" (where mBERT shows a -0.15 difference and XLM-R shows a -0.15 difference). The bars are grouped by configuration, with the mBERT bar appearing to the left of the XLM-R bar in each group, and the chart does not appear to be sorted by bar height.
